touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A small rural village with landscape character but a limited independent visitor offer.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Local outdoor access may support a dog walk, with close control around roads, livestock and wildlife.

townGuide.headline: A recorded locality pending any full destination audit
townGuide.intro: Glenkindie is assessed as a settlement in its own right; estate, riverside and wider parish attractions do not automatically raise the score.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider route
townGuide.visitorMood: Kept in the selector with its assessed score, but deliberately absent from the tourist-town map below 60.

townStudyArea.sourceName: OpenStreetMap village node with a conservative editorial study buffer
townStudyArea.notes: Glenkindie has no separate NRS locality polygon in the reference dataset. The published editorial boundary is therefore the strict heritage study area; the 500 m ring is context only.
